operations.title: Exact Rust certificate for marked octagon PC descent
Every eight-point scalar marked contact path lies in a fixed-mark associahedral face and therefore admits the established facewise PC descent.
assumptions: The entry-24 scalar-derived marked matching and distance-two prescription are retained.
Scalar X coefficients and Pochhammer q-1 normal factors remain separately typed.
The scalar grade is taken before finite-alpha-prime loading.

factorization_test.census: 132 triangulations, 12 quadrangulations, 4 zero-core sources, and two 20-occurrence matchings
factorization_test.fixed_mark: Every selected source-middle-endpoint path contains its mark d.

counterevidence: A selected path whose middle vertex omits d would falsify fixed-mark typing.
Identifying X_d with q_d-1 would double-load the normal direction and would not prove this claim.
operations.next_experiment: Use the fixed-mark map as the marked summand of the full horizontal correspondence totalization.

operations.title: The ordinary and sign-twisted loaded octagonal contact classes vanish exactly in the marked target-first PC summand.
assumptions: Entry 38's facewise PC map is support-filtered, A-linear, strongly monoidal on physical faces, and deck covariant.
The claim is restricted to the marked contact/polarity summand.
At resonance the filtered nearby-cycle object is retained rather than globally inverted.

factorization_test.support: The marked transport support is disjoint from every residual-octagon edge.
factorization_test.physical_residues: zero by scalar contact residue plus facewise PC monoidality
factorization_test.deck: one-step rotation exchanges plus and minus matchings

counterevidence: This does not prove that unmarked/full-symbol summands have zero horizontal class.
It does not select a privileged tubular-current or smooth-form representative.
operations.next_experiment: Compute the unmarked additive class in the full residue/Gysin correspondence totalization.

operations.title: The cyclic product of eight regional PC transition maps is not typed because the established horizontal maps are noninvertible residue/Gysin correspondences.
assumptions: Only maps established by scalar face incidence, target-first descent, and PC residue/Gysin naturality may be used.
No unproved equivalence between adjacent exact-core cubes is adjoined.

factorization_test.adjacent_cores: Each pair shares one physical diagonal and its nonshared diagonals cross.

counterevidence: A separately constructed derived equivalence with specified unit and coherence could make a multiplicative holonomy test meaningful.
operations.next_experiment: Replace transition products by the additive totalization of the residue/Gysin cospans.

operations.title: Assemble the unmarked/full-symbol regional PC complexes as an additive residue/Gysin correspondence on the eight-point Möbius carrier.
assumptions: Local target-first symbols of entry 82 are retained.
The marked contact summand is removed as an already-vanishing direct summand.
Occurrence support, Gysin degree, and normal orientation lines remain explicit.

factorization_test.output: Theta_O_full in the hypercohomology of the correspondence totalization

counterevidence: Replacing a cospan by an arbitrary inverse or identity changes the problem.
Local pentagon closure alone does not decide the residual Möbius H1 class.
operations.next_experiment: Construct all eight shared-rank-one cospans cellwise and compute the unmarked horizontal differential.

operations.title: The unmarked full-symbol additive octagonal class vanishes or is canonically null-homotopic in the residue/Gysin correspondence totalization.
assumptions: The full occurrence-decorated horizontal correspondence is constructible and deck covariant.
Its local restrictions agree with entries 38 and 82.
counterevidence: A nonzero component on the residual Möbius H1 class falsifies closure.
operations.next_experiment: Evaluate the full-symbol additive class after constructing the cospan totalization.

operations.title: Compute the unmarked additive octagonal class in the complete residue/Gysin correspondence totalization.
assumptions: The totalization contains all regional, shared-cut, square, and orientation-local-system terms.
The marked summand is checked separately and maps to zero.

factorization_test.pass: The unmarked class is zero or an explicit canonical null-homotopy is constructed.
factorization_test.invalid: A transition product is substituted for the correspondence totalization.

counterevidence: Vanishing after pairing with an incomplete set of periods is insufficient.
operations.next_experiment: Build the eight edge cospans and compute the cellular/hyper-Cech differential over the Möbius carrier.
